# Analysis

A computed figure, so `_freeze/` is real and figure paths get exercised. See
@fig-scatter.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Simulated data, plotted so the render produces a figure file."
set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(50)
y <- 2 * x + rnorm(50)
plot(x, y, pch = 19, col = "#1f6feb")
```
